operations.after:
typeof_specifier: $ => seq(
      choice('typeof', 'typeof_unqual', '__typeof__', '__typeof'),
      '(',
      choice(prec.dynamic(1, field('value', $.expression)), field('type', $.type_descriptor)),
      ')',
    ),

    // http://stackoverflow.com/questions/13014947/regex-to-match-a-c-style-multiline-comment/36328890#36328890

operations.before:
declaration: $ => seq(
      $._declaration_specifiers,
      commaSep1(field('declarator', choice(
        seq(
          optional($.ms_call_modifier),
          $._declaration_declarator,
operations.after:
declaration: $ => seq(
      choice($._declaration_specifiers, prec.dynamic(-1, $._type_inference_specifiers)),
      commaSep1(field('declarator', choice(
        seq(
          optional($.ms_call_modifier),
          $._declaration_declarator,

operations.before:
abstract_function_declarator: $ => prec(1, seq(
      field('declarator', optional($._abstract_declarator)),
      field('parameters', $.parameter_list),
operations.after:
abstract_function_declarator: $ => prec(1, seq(
      field('declarator', optional($._abstract_declarator)),
      field('parameters', $.parameter_list),
      repeat($.attribute_declaration),

static_assert_declaration: $ => seq(
      choice('_Static_assert', 'static_assert'),
      '(',
      field('condition', $.expression),
      optional(seq(',', field('message', $._string))),
      ')',
      ';',
    ),

    // http://stackoverflow.com/questions/13014947/regex-to-match-a-c-style-multiline-comment/36328890#36328890

operations.before:
preproc_call: $ => seq(
      field('directive', $.preproc_directive),
      field('argument', optional($.preproc_arg)),
      token.immediate(/\r?\n/),
    ),

operations.after:
_balanced_token: $ => choice(
      seq('(', repeat($._balanced_token), ')'),
      seq('[', repeat($._balanced_token), ']'),
      seq('{', repeat($._balanced_token), '}'),
      $.identifier,
      $.number_literal,
      $.char_literal,
      $.string_literal,
      $.system_lib_string,
      '::', ':', ',', ';', '.', '...', '->', '?', '!', '~', '=', '+', '-', '*', '/', '%', '&', '|', '^',
      '<', '>', '<=', '>=', '==', '!=', '&&', '||', '<<', '>>', '++', '--',
      '+=', '-=', '*=', '/=', '%=', '&=', '|=', '^=', '<<=', '>>=',
    ),

    // http://stackoverflow.com/questions/13014947/regex-to-match-a-c-style-multiline-comment/36328890#36328890

initializer_list: $ => seq(
      '{',
      repeat(choice(
        seq(choice($.initializer_pair, $.expression, $.initializer_list), ','),
        seq($.preproc_call, optional(',')),
      )),
      optional(choice($.initializer_pair, $.expression, $.initializer_list)),
      '}',
    ),

preproc_skipped: $ => repeat1(choice($._preproc_skipped_line, $._preproc_skipped_group)),
    _preproc_skipped_line: _ => token(prec(-1, /\S[^\n]*/)),
    _preproc_skipped_group: $ => seq(
      choice(preprocessor('if'), preprocessor('ifdef'), preprocessor('ifndef')),
      repeat(choice($._preproc_skipped_line, $._preproc_skipped_group)),
      repeat(seq(
        choice(preprocessor('elif'), preprocessor('elifdef'), preprocessor('elifndef'), preprocessor('else')),
        repeat(choice($._preproc_skipped_line, $._preproc_skipped_group)),
      )),
      preprocessor('endif'),
    ),

    // http://stackoverflow.com/questions/13014947/regex-to-match-a-c-style-multiline-comment/36328890#36328890

operations.before:
case_statement: $ => prec.right(seq(
      choice(
        seq('case', field('value', $.expression)),
        'default',
      ),
      ':',
      repeat(choice(
        $._non_case_statement,
        $.declaration,
        $.type_definition,
      )),
    )),
operations.after:
case_statement: $ => seq(
      choice(
        seq('case', field('value', $.expression)),
        'default',
      ),
      ':',
      repeat($._case_body_item),
    ),
    _case_body_item: $ => prec.dynamic(1, choice(
      $._non_case_statement,
      $.declaration,
      $.type_definition,
    )),

argument_list: $ => seq('(', commaSep(choice($.expression, $.compound_statement, alias($._macro_type_argument, $.type_descriptor))), ')'),
    _macro_type_argument: $ => seq(
      field('type', choice($.struct_specifier, $.union_specifier, $.enum_specifier, $.primitive_type, $.sized_type_specifier)),
      repeat($.type_qualifier),
      field('declarator', optional($._abstract_declarator)),
    ),
